scripts.scan:production: npm run build && node dist/cli.js production
scripts.scan:productionPlusTests: npm run build && node dist/cli.js productionPlusTests
scripts.scan:both: npm run build && node dist/cli.js production && node dist/cli.js productionPlusTests
scripts.workflow:prepare: npm run scan:both && npm run batch:generate
scripts.compare: npm run build && node dist/cli.js compare
scripts.observability:site: npm run observability:backfill -- --months 6 --output reports/site/observability-history.json && npm run observability:dashboard -- --input reports/site/observability-history.json --ledger reports/batch-ledger.json --output reports/site/index.html
scripts.observability: npm run observability:backfill -- --months 6 && npm run observability:dashboard
